initial.failedCase: Codex uses last request for usage and its explicit context capacity
initial.resolution: No-turn thread usage now precedes turn-specific scope admission but remains behind the root-thread fence. Existing test plus real legacy stdio now pass in the targeted run.

limitations: Windows execution and complete Electron desktop GUI/package were not run; Electron installation was unavailable in this environment.
No logged-in vendor CLI, paid model, real credentials/profile, or physical SSH host was used. Remote bridge was verified through the real adapter against a synthetic public-service port.

Strict authoritative ACK ownership applies to normal Codex turn/start. The existing /compact legacy RPC has no turn ID response and retains its separate started-event lifecycle; its existing regression passes.
Integration and release belong to the integration owner; image input, image review and GUI workbench were not implemented here.
